axes.description: XCOM grid with both K-edge endpoints; the open interval (0.0015595, 0.0015596) MeV is unsupported
axes.name: energy

description: Total aluminium mass attenuation coefficient mu/rho (coherent scattering included) on the NIST XCOM energy grid, interpolated log-log; the uncollided survival weight of a photon is exp(-mu/rho * density * path).

domain.coverage: 0.001 to 100000 MeV, except the open K-edge interval; nonfinite energies unsupported

dtype.notes: inputs are cast to float64 (float32 energies give the float64 result of their values)

legacy.format: CSV with a comment header, no manifest

name: beam.flash_attenuation.al_xcom

outputs.description: uncollided survival; NaN with supported False when unsupported
outputs.name: weight

source.description: NIST XCOM v3.1 data file MDATX3.013 (Al): coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, nuclear and electron pair cross sections, summed

split.rule: not trained: NIST data converted unchanged

unrecorded.config_hash: no build configuration beyond the data file
unrecorded.release: written by write_xcom_csv before the manifest; the commit is not recorded

validation.record: beam/tests/test_flash_attenuation.py: NIST public values, every table node, log-log interpolation, the K edge
